serverInfo.name: cyan-printing-mcp
serverInfo.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Cyan Printing (مطبعة سيان) Kuwait. Exposes tools for printing catalog inquiry, custom packaging specifications, and quote generation.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Retrieve official company information, operating location in Kuwait, customer service channels, and subsidiary details for Cyan Printing.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List all printing and packaging services: Boxes & Cartons, Paper Bags, Paper Cups, Packaging Materials, and Corporate Printing.

tools.name: request_quote_info
tools.description: Retrieve quote requirements, dimensions guidance, material options, and the direct WhatsApp contact link for order placement.

product_type.description: Product type (e.g. Perfume Box, Gift Bag, Coffee Cup, Stickers)

tools.name: get_subsidiaries
tools.description: Retrieve information on Cyan Advertising (exhibitions, booths, signage) and Mansi Line (card holders, acrylic, UV printing, DTF textiles).
